meta: A prioritized review of your React Native app: code, speed, crashes and store rules, plus an optional call. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: React Native audit that ranks what to fix first
overview: Send us your repository and, if you have them, your crash and store reports. We read the code, run the app on both platforms and check structure, performance, dependency health, security basics and store requirements. You receive a written report that ranks every finding by effort and impact, so you can fix the most valuable items first. The larger packages include a 1-on-1 call.

faq: Do you change my code during the audit?
No, except for the sample fixes in the Premium package, which come as a separate pull request. The audit itself only reads and reports, so your code stays as it is.
What do you need from me?
Read access to the repository, a way to run the app, and any crash or analytics reports you have. A short note on your biggest worry helps us aim the review where it counts.
Yes. Your code and report stay private to you and us. We can sign a short confidentiality note before you share anything, if you prefer.
Can you fix the findings afterwards?
Yes. We can quote the fixes separately, or you can hand the report to your own developers. The report is written so another developer can act on it without us.
